summary: Polyrizon Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing the notice and proxy statement for its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held July 13, 2026. The meeting agenda includes director re-elections, approval of compensation policy, equity awards, and auditor re-appointment. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing is a routine proxy solicitation for an annual meeting. No special-situation classification applies.
